entries.title: Webinars: run webinars on ON24, with resources viewed
entries.summary: ON24 is now a webinar platform for **Program → Webinars**: create and update webcasts in ON24, register people, and bring back live attendance, ON24's engagement score, poll answers, Q&A, group chat, reactions, CTA widgets, survey answers and the resources each attendee viewed, plus the archive recording into Media.

enable.path: Organization → Preview → Field Events → Request access

entries.use_case: Customers who run their webinar program on ON24 get the same loop as Zoom and Goldcast, with ON24's richer engagement data on every contact record.

cs_action.note: Webinars ride on the Field Events Early Access; connecting the provider app is a per-org step in Apps.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer runs webinars on ON24, especially medical and B2B marketing teams who rely on ON24 engagement scores.
internal.staff_path: Apps → the provider, then Program → Webinars
internal.gotchas: ON24's API cannot add presenters: speakers are added in ON24 Presentation Manager. ON24 has no personal join link. Orgs on the legacy ON24 import reuse its credentials automatically. Not yet verified against a live ON24 account (time zone codes, archive download auth).
internal.talk_track: Your ON24 webcasts, with every engagement signal ON24 captures, on the contact record.

entries.title: Goldcast webinars: reliable publish, reschedule, registration and attendance
entries.summary: Goldcast webinars now publish, reschedule and sync on Goldcast's documented API only: speakers land on the session, test events show a **Test** badge in the import list, ratings on Goldcast's 1 to 5 scale count toward the Speaker Score, and attendance comes from each registrant's live, on-demand or in-person record.

enable.path: Organization → Preview → Field Events → Request access

entries.use_case: Goldcast webinars stay in step with Studio, and the attendance and ratings that come back are complete enough to act on.

cs_action.note: Webinars ride on the Field Events Early Access; connecting the provider app is a per-org step in Apps.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a Goldcast customer reports missing attendance or speakers in Studio.
internal.staff_path: Apps → the provider, then Program → Webinars
internal.gotchas: Goldcast's session attendance report answers HTML 500, so attendance is read from event members. On the test account Goldcast's documented registration endpoint answered success without adding the registrant; the push now fails honestly and retries. A move that exceeds the account's longest allowed event must be made in Studio.
internal.talk_track: Goldcast and Sessionboard agree on who came and how they rated it.

entries.title: Webinars: walk-ins count, one Dispatch per webinar, nudges every 12 hours at most
entries.summary: People who join a webinar without registering are now added as checked-in registrants, so their attendance and engagement count. Reopening **Share with your team** returns the webinar's existing Dispatch draft, the social pack is written in the background, a teammate is nudged at most once every 12 hours, and a double click never sends or posts twice.

enable.path: Organization → Preview → Field Events → Request access

where.path: Program → Webinars → a webinar → People and After

entries.use_case: Attendance reports include everyone who showed up, and teammates are reminded without being spammed.

cs_action.note: Webinars ride on the Field Events Early Access; connecting the provider app is a per-org step in Apps.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer asks why some attendees were missing from a webinar report, or about repeated Dispatch reminders.
internal.staff_path: Apps → the provider, then Program → Webinars
internal.gotchas: Walk-ins need an email address from the provider; hosts and presenters are never added. The nudge toast still counts everyone who has not shared, including people inside the 12-hour cooldown who were not emailed. The 'Writing the posts' state needs web-ui-v2 #1393.
internal.talk_track: Everyone who came is counted; nobody gets nagged.

entries.title: Apps: a Webinars category, with every webinar platform open to every organization
entries.summary: **Apps** now has a **Webinars** category holding Zoom Webinars, Goldcast, ON24 and the other webinar platforms, and any organization can connect them without Early Access. Creating and running webinars from **Program → Webinars** is still part of the Field Events Early Access.
entries.use_case: Customers find their webinar platform in one place and can connect it straight away, for recordings in Media and webinar history in Speaker CRM.

cs_action.note: Connecting is open to everyone; turn on Field Events Early Access for customers who want to run webinars from Program → Webinars.

internal.when_to_bring_up: When a customer asks which webinar platforms Sessionboard connects to.
internal.gotchas: The Zoom app is still a Draft in the Zoom Marketplace, so only Zoom users on Sessionboard's own account can authorize it until Zoom's review passes. BigMarker, GoTo Webinar, Webex Webinars and Microsoft Teams Webinars cards appear as their own releases ship.
internal.talk_track: Every webinar platform you use, one click away.
